name: @playliquid/lab-learning
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Lab learning/calibration (PL-030). The learning layer of the Game Engineering Lab loop (spec/architecture.md §Lab loop: "observed outcome → calibration → next search"): tenant-scoped, append-only learning-cycle records that fold one completed Lab cycle's artifacts — the observation ledger with its appended calibration conclusions, the evaluation run records' evidence digests and the search result digests — into immutable, content-addressed records (E10 receipt pattern: identical cycle content derives the same record id; a duplicate intake returns the existing record as a typed idempotent receipt, never a second copy, never an error; there is no update, revise or rewrite operation anywhere). A deterministic pure fold derives typed learning signals (dimension-level outcome affinities: which candidate-dimension values co-occurred with which observed-outcome summaries) and rung-classified recurring capability-gap summaries (R18: existing → alternate → package/platform capability → user/community contribution → Arena → blocked; recorded and typed with recurrence counts — never silently skipped, never auto-escalated). The top-level product is a typed search-guidance object that parameterizes lab-organization's next search request (dimension bounds adjustments, ordering hints, baseline promotion notes, a deterministic seed hint) derived ONLY from the learning state; epistemic discipline is structural (E11, lock 28/29): guidance derived wholly or partly from simulator/counterfactual estimates carries the labeled-estimate marker and is structurally disjoint from observed-evidence-derived guidance — a stripped or forged marker is a typed refusal. This package NEVER mutates any lab-contracts ledger (E10): all inputs are read-only views; the only writes are appends to its own learning-cycle records. Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner (E1); time and persistence live behind ports with deterministic in-memory fakes that wire the REAL PL-029 search and PL-028 evaluation engines for tests and the harness; no network, no Arena escalation runtime, no re-implementation of lab-simulation's evaluation or lab-organization's compiler/search.
